reason: I already paid an agency once and got zero meetings, and now you want EUR 5,000 locked in over three months with no meetings promised. I can buy Apollo for a fraction of that and have one of my guys send the emails himself.
objection: Nobody guarantees anything, so I pay EUR 1,500 a month whatever happens, and the first meetings might not even show up until the second month. It's the same story as the last agency, just told more honestly.
would_change_my_mind: A month-to-month trial with no three-month lock-in, or part of the fee only paid per real meeting with a buyer who fits my profile.
